title: Cost of Localizing Video Ads Into Other Languages in 2026
summary: What AI video localization costs, from translation credits to new Spanish ads, with published prices from HeyGen, Arcads and agencies, checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
Localizing a video ad costs credits when you translate an ad that already works, and costs like a new ad when you write a new script and cast a presenter for each language. Most published prices here are credits rather than dollars, and for a Spanish ad the script and native review matter as much as the translation. Knowlify is the done-for-you route we recommend for finished AI video ads, but confirm its languages and voice quality in a quote before you order. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## Three routes and what each one costs


**Route one: translate an ad you already have.**[HeyGen describes lip-matched video translation across more than 175 languages and dialects](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) , and its Creator plan is $29 a month billed monthly, or $24 billed annually, with 600 credits.[Arcads lists 240 credits for translation and 80 for captions](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/13725589-how-are-credits-counted) on its credit schedule. This route keeps the existing edit, so the cost is mostly credits and review time.


**Route two: write a new script and cast a presenter who speaks the language.**[Arcads says its talking actors speak 74 languages](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17350051-arcads-faq) , and its schedule charges 800 credits per rounded-up minute for each talking actor. A real-creator batch costs like a new production.[Brighter Click sells 12 edited videos from four creators for $4,500](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) , and our sources do not say which languages its creators speak.


**Route three: buy an agency that makes ads in several languages.**[Creative Milkshake says it makes ads in English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Portuguese](https://www.creativemilkshake.com/) , and[its locations page](https://www.creativemilkshake.com/locations) lists hubs in six European cities.[Adguns includes language versions in weekly batches from €1,000 a month](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) , with media buying excluded.

## HeyGen and Arcads: what the credits buy


[HeyGen's Creator plan works out to about $1.50 per minute of Avatar IV video](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) , by our arithmetic: $29 for 600 credits, at 31 credits a minute. That is about 19 minutes a month before any translation charge, since 600 divided by 31 is roughly 19. HeyGen's[avatar guidance](https://help.heygen.com/en/articles/15544929-avatar-voice-faq-troubleshooting-best-practices-and-credits) says changes to A-Roll scenes require re-rendering and consume credits, so a corrected line can cost a second generation. Budget for the fix as well as the first render.


Put that in terms of one ad. A 30-second Avatar IV video uses about 16 credits at the same rate (31 credits a minute, rounded up), so the Creator allowance covers roughly 37 such renders a month before any translation or re-render charge. If a Spanish version needs two re-renders after review, that one ad uses three generations' worth of credits, about 48. That is why the review step belongs in the budget from the start. For a fuller breakdown of HeyGen's plans, see our[HeyGen pricing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/heygen-pricing) .


[Arcads publishes monthly allowances from 8,000 credits on Starter to 192,000 on Business, with no dollar prices on its public pages](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17350051-arcads-faq) . Its credit schedule charges 800 credits per rounded-up minute per talking actor, so a new Spanish ad of a minute or less is 800 credits and Starter's 8,000 credits cover about ten such renders before captions, translation or retries (our arithmetic). Its FAQ also describes a 72-hour trial with 1,000 credits and a card required, which converts to Starter unless you cancel. Check the renewal amount at signup before you budget a pilot. For a wider comparison, see our[Arcads pricing and alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/arcads-pricing-and-alternatives) .


## Knowlify: finished AI video ads without credits to manage


Knowlify is the done-for-you route we recommend if you would rather receive finished ads than spend credits and review every render yourself. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, the first batch lands on day five, and a person checks every ad before delivery. The three formats are AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials, so one offer can be tested in more than one look. You can take creative only or have Knowlify run your Meta campaigns, pricing is a custom quote, and if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on[the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.


**When to pick another option:** we have not confirmed a language list for Knowlify, so get the languages and the native-speaker review in writing. If you need a team that already lists Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Portuguese, Creative Milkshake does. For what a full video ad costs by production model, see our[video ad production cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-production-cost) .
